items.title: Reindeer Peeking Around a Pine Sprig
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon reindeer peeking around a small upright pine sprig tied with a red bow.
items.description: A swept cream forelock and wide antler crown rise above the little pine branch. The reindeer's long muzzle and two front hooves remain visible on either side of the greenery.

items.title: Three Different Christmas Reindeer
items.alt: Three distinct cartoon reindeer arranged together: a seated cinnamon animal, a tall gray one in a cream scarf and a dark-brown one stepping forward.
items.description: Different faces, antlers and body proportions give each member of the trio its own identity. A red bell collar, cream scarf and green bell bow distinguish their outfits.

items.title: Reindeer Greeting a Tiny Snowman
items.alt: Brown cartoon reindeer lowering its nose to the carrot nose of a tiny snowman wearing a green knitted cap.
items.description: The three-ball snowman smiles up with twig arms spread. Cream cheek fur, small white back spots and broad antlers distinguish the four-legged reindeer beside it.

items.title: Reindeer Holding a Holly Sprig
items.alt: Seated cartoon reindeer with large brown eyes holding a small holly sprig in its mouth and wearing a cream bow near one ear.
items.description: The folded legs form a long horizontal base below the reindeer's upright chest. Delicate antler branches and a white cheek ruff frame the gentle face above the red berries.

items.title: Reindeer Presenting a Blank Wooden Sign
items.alt: Teal-eyed cartoon reindeer standing behind a blank wooden sign with two forehooves on its upper edge and rear hooves below.
items.description: Rounded wood grain fills the empty sign, leaving space for a visitor's own wording. A dark forelock, cream chest and wide antlers rise clearly above it.

items.title: Reindeer Riding a Red Sled
items.alt: Smiling cartoon reindeer seated on a red sled, wearing a green pom-pom beanie and a fringed gold scarf.
items.description: The reindeer gathers all four hooves on the sled's slatted seat. Gold curved runners and a forward-curling front support complete the little winter vehicle.
